subject: E-Commerce
title: The Shopping Cart Icon
description: A quick, practical guide to The Shopping Cart Icon.

hook.text: Every online store uses a shopping cart icon. The metaphor was borrowed directly from physical grocery stores.

buildup.text: The physical shopping cart was invented in 1937 by Sylvan Goldman, an Oklahoma grocery store owner.

discovery.text: Early websites tested bag icons, basket icons, and list views. The cart won because it felt familiar.

twist.text: The 'Add to Cart' button is the most clicked button in commerce history. Its design drives billions.

climax.text: Changing a cart button's color or placement can shift millions in revenue. Tiny tweaks, huge stakes.

punchline.text: A 1937 grocery invention became the internet's most important icon.

quiz.question: When was the physical shopping cart invented?
